summary: Answer strict exact RFI and Submittal Ball in Court, Priority, Discipline and Location questions locally and ground the same identity, role and complete value in model-generated answers and source findings.
decision_refs: The active objective requires efficient accurate questions across RFI, Submittal and Email content
Ball in Court is a useful explicit workflow field but must not be reinterpreted as Assigned To or inferred responsibility
The existing workflow index and immutable evidence can answer exact labelled fields without a second index or provider cost
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email question flows.
known_limitations: Only strict English questions naming one exact RFI or Submittal and one supported printed coordination field use the local shortcut.
Email headers, quoted history, signatures, ordinary prose and unlabeled text remain outside the field contract.
More than 32 primary files or candidate passages and conflicting explicit values fail closed.
The implementation does not infer responsibility, applicability, routing, urgency, trade, place, approval, chronology, authority, action ownership or equivalence between distinct field roles.
